correct.evidence: Point 18's shot bullet fails on every screen: web writes data-landmark="timeline" (web/src/lib/shots.ts:28), desktop looks for [data-landmark="/timeline"] (desktop/src/shots.ts:136,149); 8 of 8 fail in a scratch test. The SPEC's pending twin gets an invented cap_gap.h9.ends_before_starts conflict. A belonging petition starting 2026-06-09 or 2027-05-03 keeps grace.h9 2028-06-09 to 2028-08-07. Twenty journeys unchanged from fix 4; T1, T3, T4, P1 right by hand.

sourced.evidence: verify, plain, engine_literals exit 0; capgap.status_ends_on_h1b_start note states point 18. The April 1 cut on the petition grace (parameters.yaml:2001) has no source for a start that is not a cap-gap start.

never_assumes.evidence: Missing outcome and validity_start are asked and validation dates go null. But a pending petition or an approved one without validity_start opens cap_gap with a conflict no record holds, and an old denied or withdrawn 2020 petition takes the grace.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: No new string states a conclusion about a person; the invented conflict is shown as 'Two documents disagree on ...' (web/src/lib/status.ts:65), untrue of the record.

secure.evidence: Nothing new takes outside input; twenty journeys, all twins, sixteen probes and three walked cases returned 200.

tested.evidence: Mutants m3 (null-while-unsettled member) and m5 (cap_gap card-end filter) pass every acceptance and holdout test; m1, m2, m6 caught; m4 equivalent. No test joins the web landmark value to the desktop selector; first-day and pending twins assert only validations.

findings.title: Web and desktop spell the landmark differently, so no shot is ever counted as drawn
findings.input: holdsLandmark([{landmark: LANDMARKS[screen], width: 300, height: 40}], screen) for each of the 8 SHOT_SCREENS, LANDMARKS from web/src/lib/shots.ts:28
findings.what_happens: False for all 8 (web writes "home", "timeline"; run looks for "/", "/timeline"); every make design-shots exits 1.

findings.title: A belonging petition starting after April 1 of its fiscal year keeps a grace dated after the card
findings.input: J19 plus h9 {h1b, change_of_status yes, cap_subject no, approved, filed_on 2026-07-01, validity_start 2027-05-03}; also the acceptance twin with validity_start 2026-06-09 (test_journeys.py:2114)
findings.what_happens: Validations after the start go null, yet grace.h9 2028-06-09 to 2028-08-07 is shown, long after H-1B status began; point 18 says a belonging petition takes the grace away.

findings.title: Pending or unapproved petitions open cap_gap with an invented conflict or take the grace, at any date
findings.input: J19 plus h9 pending filed 2026-07-01 requested_start 2027-03-01 (SPEC-named twin); J19 plus h9 denied filed 2020-04-01 validity_start 2020-10-01; J19 plus h9 withdrawn 2020
findings.what_happens: Pending: cap_gap.h9 2028-06-09 to 2027-04-01 with conflict cap_gap.h9.ends_before_starts. Old denied: grace.p2 gone, judgement grace.after_cap_gap_outcome.h9. Old withdrawn: grace gone plus cap_gap.h9 2028-06-09 to 2020-06-01 with the conflict.

findings.title: Two point 18 rules pass every test when removed
findings.input: m3: remove the stem_validation_end member that nulls dates while belonging is unsettled; m5: remove the cap_gap validity-start-after-card-end filter
findings.what_happens: m3: validations shown as due for a petition with no validity_start or outcome; m5: conflict returns on T3, T4, P1 and the denied twin. Acceptance and holdout pass under both.

findings.title: An approved start before the current card is silently ignored
findings.input: J19 plus h9 approved validity_start 2025-10-01 (inside a1) or 2026-06-08
findings.what_happens: No conflict and no question, though by the pack's reading F-1 status ended then and a2 followed; point 18 says an older petition raises no conflict. Under disputes.
